description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of different LLaMA-2 model sizes—specifically LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B—on the CoLeG-R benchmark, measured as a percentage, under varying fine-tuning conditions. The vertical axis represents CoLeG-R (%) ranging from 0 to 80 with tick marks at intervals of 10, while the horizontal axis lists the three model sizes. For each model, four bars are grouped together, corresponding to different fine-tuning strategies as indicated in the legend: “no SFT” (light blue with diagonal stripes), “+ SFT on D₀” (light orange with horizontal stripes), “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” (light purple with diagonal stripes), and “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” (light red with no pattern). Performance generally increases with both model size and the extent of supervised fine-tuning (SFT), with the largest model (LLaMA-2-70B) under full fine-tuning achieving the highest score, approaching 85%, while the smallest model without SFT scores around 70%. The chart is tilted slightly clockwise, and the bars are arranged in descending order of performance within each model group, visually emphasizing the incremental gains from additional fine-tuning data.
